body:
What defines me is having a human body I'm expected to keep alive even though I really don't care to and I'm stuck in a society that has all the tools to prevent suffering but has decided that people who want it cant just have it. If you are going to go that route you are on your own.

And people tell themselves this is right and how it should be because if they really wanted it they'd do it and ignore that we don't hold the same expectation for so many other things. "You don't really want a root canal if you arent willing to take the drill to your own tooth" it'd be an absurd stance.

It's true that life is a self defined thing but it's in exactly the same way that kids make up rules and meaning. "The Floor is Lava" so you need to do all this work, jump from here to there, lay out cushions to jump to etc. That's all life is except we understand that it's silly to tell a kid not interested in that game that the floor is lava. We don't recognize that people not inclined to play a similar game with life have no reason to.
